fields.description: CLF is an 18-month experience that includes 6 retreats, 13 dinner gatherings, monthly mentoring, and weekly or bi-weekly small groups. We ask that both partners are fully committed to participating throughout the duration.

applicants.message:
Dear {Husband — first name:2} and {Wife — first name:9},

Thank you for applying to the Charlotte Leadership Forum. We have received your application and will be in touch soon about next steps.

Your five references will each receive a short email from us.

— The Charlotte Leadership Forum

ref1.name: Reference email — Couple Church pastor
ref1.subject: {Husband — first name:2} & {Wife — first name:9} listed you as a reference for the Charlotte Leadership Forum
ref1.message:
Hello,

{Husband — first name:2} and {Wife — first name:9} have applied to the Charlotte Leadership Forum, an 18-month leadership development experience for young married couples, and listed you as a reference (couple — church pastor).

Someone from CLF will follow up with a few short, confidential questions. If you prefer, you can simply reply to this email with your perspective on the applicant(s).

Thank you for your time,
The Charlotte Leadership Forum
